SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: Number of Fatality Work-Related Injury is the number that results in fatality regardless of sudden death or suffering consequences and subsequent death.

SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: Fatality Work-Related Injury Rate from workplace is the number that results in fatality case (person) per 1,000,000 hours worked.

SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: Total Number of Recordable Work-Related Injury from workplace is the number that results in fatality, lost time, restricted work or medical treatment.

SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: Total Recordable Work-Related Injury Rate from workplace is the number that results in fatality, lost time, restricted work or medical treatment case (person) per 1,000,000 hours worked.

SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: Number of High-Consequence Work-Related Injury from workplace is the number that results in high-consequence, excluding fatality.

SCG records the data based on work-related in health and safety as followed: High-Consequence Work-Related Injury Rate from workplace is the number that results in high consequence excluding fatality case (person) per 1,000,000 hours worked.
